basic_info.description: Russian Hill Opportunity! Five-Unit Building in One of the Most Desirable Neighborhoods in San Francisco. Four updated units! Great opportunity to increase your portfolio value. Situated in a quiet and private cul-de-sac, this building offers four one-bedroom units (all occupied) and one three-bedroom unit. Prime location! Only minutes away from Columbus Ave, walking distance to our famous SF Fisherman's Wharf, Joe DiMaggio Playground, North Beach restaurants and attractions, Washington Square Park, Chinatown, and the Financial District. High income and a great tenant. Previous abatement orders and prior violations have already been paid for and corrected. The building department abatement order has been removed, and the case has been closed. The building has no inspection reports, and the seller won't conduct any inspections. All units are occupied and can be shown after offer acceptance, subject to a visual inspection by the buyer(s). Any offers must provide a Verification of Funds (VOF) and a recent approval letter in case of a financed purchase offer. Units Occupied: #176 ($700.00 per month, protected tenant), Unit 176A ($3,000 per month), Unit #178 ($2,230 per month), Unit #180 ($2,190 per month), Unit #182 ($2,260 per month).
